description: This file defines the ArgUtils class, which provides utility methods for handling argument arrays, specifically transforming multidimensional arrays into one-dimensional lists. It contains only static methods and belongs to the org.apache.commons.math3.exception.util package.

classes.name: ArgUtils
classes.description: Utility class for transforming argument lists used in exception constructors. Contains only static methods.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Transforms a possibly multidimensional array into a one-dimensional array containing all elements.
